paper_title: No evidence for axions from Chandra observation of magnetic white dwarf
notes: MWD X-ray observation. Primary result is limit on product g_aee*g_agamma < 1.3e-25 GeV^-1 for m_a << 5e-6 eV. Translated to g_agamma <= 5.5e-13 sqrt(C_agamma/C_aee) GeV^-1 for C_aee=C_agamma scenario. Encoded as flat horizontal line over m_a range ~1e-11 to 5e-6 eV where limit applies. Note: paper's fundamental measured quantity is the product coupling; the g_agamma value assumes tree-level C_aee=C_agamma. Could alternatively be reported as AxionElectron.
